Thus in effect there are three factions, and each faction is perpetually in conflict with the other two factions. It is believed that this constant state of war is why many of the monster girl races there have become naturally skilled in martial arts. Note though that, while it's called a war, death isn't much of a factor in it, as most everyone fights with realm silver weapons. As for the three factions:

The Land of the Four Gods is a bright green mamono realm ruled by four great monsters often revered as deities. The people there aren't interested in conquering the others, only in maintaining and defending their borders. Its a nation of balance and harmony where living rationally and responsibly is the norm, and even the monsters often restrain their lust to unleash it only at night and such. Of course discipline is still looser than in many human societies.

The Land of the Four Fiends is ruled by four exceedingly licentious monsters, and the dark realm state of the land reflects this. Basically its an extreme dark mamono realm, with all that entails. Even monsters like jinko are raging beasts, always in heat. Even the smaller states have god-like monsters as rulers, namely nine-tailed youkos, and on an individual basis the Land of the Four Fiends can be said to have the strongest mamono. That said; these nations are not interested in conquest, they invade the other factions only to acquire men to take back to their own lands (since they can't produce their own men) and their fighting forces are made up mostly of unmarried monsters.

The Land of the Four Souls is a human-dominated set of nations presided over by a bold emperor. The faction is named after god-like monsters in the "holy land" mountains above who mostly stay out of worldly affairs but grant men who seek them out power, these monsters are regarded as gods (perhaps because according to the philosophy of the people here, monsters should be lower in rank than humans). Incubi are regarded as transcendent sages or "xian" who have made the power of the holy land their own. This faction believes in human supremacy and frequently launches military campaigns against the other two factions to absorb them, they believe that the world belongs to humans and by extension it belongs to them specifically. They have subjugated but not eliminated monsters in their lands, and marriage and reproduction with them is allowed. It is mostly the men who fight, but some have monster retainers. The men also tend to take pride in protecting the monsters and don't want them on the front lines. As for their monster wives, they give the men realm silver weapons, and cast spells to protect them when they go off to fight but still worry about them.

entries.name: Behiti Desert
entries.content:
Behiti is the only Desert on earth, and as such, it has its own variety of monster girls, such as Sphinx, Anubis, Khepri, sandworms, and more. Originally ruled by the pharaoh, it has since turned into a lewd mamono realm by the conniving and seductive Heba, the apophis, a strong lamia of immense mamono energy. After infecting Dendara, the pharaoh with her lewd toxins, all of Behiti follows Heba as she rules the desert region with authority.

Currently,  Behiti is a ruined land where desert stretches on and on. Many monsters that live there are subordinates of Heba, including “anubis” “sphinx” and “mummy.” It is dotted with the ruins of a kingdom that was destroyed in the era of the former mamono lord. Many adventurers and thieves visit the land seeking the many treasures that rest there. But there are a lot of monsters who go after the adventurers, and it's a dangerous land where most of them end up disappearing and being taken away. One would think that it would be an extremely harsh environment to survive in, but every place has been outfitted by the monsters. Every place is dotted with many caves to stave off the heat and for bringing back men, and ruins. Plus, there are many monster villages centered around oases. 

Common mamono encountered here: Mummies, Sphinxes, Anubi, Gandharvas, Lamias, Girtabilus, Sandworms, Corrupted Pharaohs, Apophisi, Khepri, Ghouls, Basilisks, Genies, and Griffons

entries.name: Volcano
entries.content:
Certain mamono races are adapted to live in environments that are typically inhospitable to humans. The fiery locales are described as places that would likely burn humans to ash (such as amidst flames or in the heart of a volcano), are ones monsters strut through with pride. An environment's harshness correlates to the difficulty humans have making a home there - as well as to the totality of the monsters' control. As might be expected, the relationship between humans and monsters is quite different in such regions when compared to others. With chimeras and hellhounds making their home there, it's obvious why many cities struggle to claim volcanos as potential mining colonies.

Near much larger volcanoes, there are almost always large monster cities. Volcanoes regarded as dangerous in each land have great fiends called "Balrogs" living there and controlling the mountains to prevent eruptions. If there's a balrog in a volcano, then the surrounding area will be ruled by that balrog, and naturally, a city centered around the balrog will be established. These cites are hedonistic in nature as the beautiful balrog and her minions establish control over the volcanic region. The best example of this, is the Balrog Mordra defeating and capturing several battalions of Menria's finest for her subjects to breed with as she blocked off the entrance to her city, denying humans access to the valuable ore unless Menria gives in to her rule.

Commonly found mamono in this region: Balrogs, Ignis, Pyrrows, Hellhounds, Chimeras, Hinezumi (Mist), Salamander, Cyclops, Dwarves, Lava Golem, Phoenix, and a Manticore

entries.name: Snow
entries.content:
Snowy Regions are areas littered with freezing snow as the name suggest. It's incredibly dangerous due to the terrain within, but the bigger threats to humsns are the mamono that are actively seeking husbands for breeding and consumption of semen. Many threats within the wintery lands are quite small in number, but still something that shouldn't be ignored. Many of these regions are up north or in high mountain villages.

Commonly encountered mamono: Winter Horn, Wendigo, Glacies (Frozen Continent), Ice Queen (Frozen Continent), Yeti, Selkie, Krampus, Yuki-Onna (Zipangu), and Tsurara-Onna (Zipangu)

entries.name: Water
entries.content:
Water is a necessity of life, bringing  health and strength to all things that need it. As such, mamono and humans are often nearby depending on the territory. There are many types of aquatic mamono  that swim through the waters of the planet. 

In the mainland of continents, most mamono seen are usually in rivers, marshlands, lakes, and swamps. This is the habitat for Bunyips, Kappa (Zipangu) Undines, Kelpies, Sahagins, Mucus Toads 
Apsara, Mantango, Vamp Mosquito, and Giant Slugs, who are capable of movement on land, but reside in the water as their habitat. 

Within the ocean are where most of the aquatic mamono reside, such as Sea Bishops, Mermaids, Otohimes (Zipangu), Merrows, Mersharks, Nerenids, Charybidis, Cancers, Krakens, Sea Slimes, and Scyllas.

Most aquatic mamono pay dear respects to Poseiden, the one that cares for the mamono as if they are the Goddess's children. It's why most undersea monster girls live in the ever-expanding Neptunian Republic, a safe haven for underwater mamono.

entries.name: Grassland
entries.content:
A common region among many landscapes, known for its green vibrant grass and the extraordinary view of the world. It's quite mesmerizing, yet as one would expect, mamono roam the area, although usually they aren't much of a threat unless a minotaur or some other powerful mamono starts skulking about. Many outposts and mini territorys are located here, but most of them aren't recognized by any governing body, like the Hive in Luce or the underground ant mamono colony in Trutale

Commonly found mamono: Ant Arachne, Black Harpies, Centaurs, Giant Ants, Greenworms, Harpies, Holstaurs, Honey Bees, Kobolds, Mandragoras, Minotaurs, Papillons, Queen Slimes, Red Slimes, Satyr, Slimes, Wererabbits, Weresheeps

entries.name: Forests
entries.content:
Forests are a common sight in world, being the place where many travelers go to and explore the wondrous area before them. As expected, many mamono roam this forested lands, seeking out their potential husband while having residence there. Most forests are ruled by the mamono, and the ruler is usually a dryad or an amazon if a tribe of them is established.

Commonly found forest mamono: Alraunes, Amazons, Ant Arachnes, Centaurs, Dryads, Elfs, Giant Ants, Giant Slugs, Greenworms, Grizzlys, Honey Bees, Hornets, Jinkos (Mist), Liliraunes, Mandragoras, Matangos, Mothmen, Myconids, Owl Mages, Papillons, Pixies, Ratatoskrs, Satyros, Soldier Beetles, Werecats, and Werewolves

Deeper into a forest, one might encounter, Arachne, Manti, Unicorns, and Witches, but witches mean that a Sabbath base is nearby.

entries.name: Mountains
entries.content:
Mountains are another staple part of a continent, serving as a natural border from invaders, mountains are also home to many mamono who reside within the treacherous mountains. Such mountains include Topaz Gorge of Melran or Aoiyama of Zipangu. These mountains also hold vast cave systems, holding even more ore for mining. Dragonia is another region known for its mountains, infact, it's surrounded by mostly mountains and it's various cities

Commonly found mamono in this region: Barometz, Black Harpies, Chimeras, Grizzlies, Harpies, High Orcs, Jinko (Mist), Manticore, Mothmen, Orcs, Soldier Beetles, Sylphs, Thunderbirds, Werewolves, Cockatrices, Dragon (Dragonia), Dragon Zombie (Dragonia), Goblin, Hobgoblin, Kobold, Ogre, Wurms (Dragonia), Wyverns (Dragonia), and Cyclopses

entries.name: Caves
entries.content:
Caves, a place of eternal darkness and stone, and yet a habitat for many mamono. In this ecosystem, many mamono have adjusted to the everday sight of nothingness that spans throughout the underground. Many caves exist, from volcanic Heat Vents to frozen Ice Tunnels, and yet, the mamono still survive in the region with their human husbands.

The most notable cavern was Menria's Sache Caverns of the Melran Continent. It is an iconic symbol that has since fallen to the abyss as abyssal mamono as well as other strong mamono made it impossible for miners to do their job without getting milked leaving the place like a ghost town as many human tools and shacks are still within the mamono-infested ruins.

Most commonly found mamono in the region: Ant Arachne, Arachne, Atlach-Nachas, Devil Bugs, Doromes, Dwarves, Giant Ants, Gnomes, Large Mice, Lizardmen, Mimics, Mindflayers, Minotaurs, Myconids, Night Gaunts, Parasite Slimes / Slime Carriers, Ropers, Shoggoths, Trolls, and Werebats.

entries.name: Ruins
entries.content:
A symbol of days long past, many ruins litter the world, signifying decay and degradation of a once powerful society that was much more advanced than what is available now. One can find ruins anywhere, but the most lucrative are the ones out of sight. However, these areas are extremely dangerous as they hold lewd mamono and lewd traps, constructed to aid in the intruders' inevitable corruption. Such sights are the greed-induced Creeping Coin, the stalking Gargoyles and even the invincible Golems and automatons, who have recently been monsterized, granting them the power to rape human men for breeding and refueling.

Commonly found mamono in this region: Automatons, Cursed Swords, Gremlins, Liches, Living Armor, Parasite Slimes / Slime Carriers, Phantoms, Redcaps, Wights, Will-o-the-Wisps Golems Living Dolls, Echidna, and Gargoyles.

entries.name: Polove
entries.content:
Polove was small poor nation in Tolbiz but in recent years sense it's monsterization due to Lescatie falling, it is now a booming town of lewd elemental magic. Once the homeland of Saphirette Spherica and the base of the Elementalist Association. It is presumably located somewhere on the Order's continent. Previously, it was neutral state, but in recent times it has been converted into a scholarly Green Mamono Realm, the only green one in Tolbi.

Saphirette, who was an apprentice scholar at the time, attempted to heal the land using four pure elementals, but was unsuccessful. Aware that mamono mana can increase elementals' powers, she ventured into the Mamono Realm and was monsterized by a dark matter, transforming into one herself. Together, the they returned to Polove and began pouring mamono mana into the earth.

Even though elementalists used to be rare due to a lack of elementals, in recent years, mamono elementals have been increasing in number, and the elementals themselves have begun to act aggressively to get a covenanter, a husband, so the number of elementalists is on the rise, which eventually enabled the Elementalist Association to be established within Polove. Since the monsterization, Wesple and other Holy Order countries are forbidden from interacting with Polove due to the proximity of Lescatie.

entries.name: Dragonia
entries.content:
Dragonia is both a continent and nation in the world, and that is distinct by being ruled and inhabited primarily by Dragon Monster Girls. Described as a "great country where dragons and humans coexist", Dragonia is considered a "natural fortress" due to being covered and surrounded by large mountain ranges, and is east of Wendel, and is one of the largest continents and is comprised of both "Bright Green" and "Dark" Monster Realms. However, most of Dragonia is a green mamono realm, meaning that unlike “dark mamono realm”, the sky is bright blue during the day, and the brilliant light of the sun illuminates the earth. The ashen earth that receives sunlight is covered with green plants. 

Within Dragonia is Malitice, the large region that has succumb to the dark mamono realm andnis controlled by the royal dark dragon family of Letian.
Currently ruled by the Baroness, Fortimia Deadra Letian, her territory is at odds with the Queen of Dragonia, and the Holy Order countries of Wesple, who reside in a nearby continent Wendel. The human country is ruled by the "Holy Order of the Chief Goddess" aka "Holy Order, a religious organization that forbids humans and mamono from coexisting as it is deemed as a major sin within the church teachings.
As expected of the Holy Order, the religious organization sent out human heros to take destroy it only to end in failure and for the human men that were captured to mate with monster girls which creates stronger mamono breeds that inevitably aided in Malitice's expansion into Dragonia.

entries.name: Pandemonium
entries.content:
Pandemonium is a spirit realm ruled by the Fallen Goddess. It is the lair of dark angels and dark valkyries, it is a dimension where time flows strangely, a place where no one grows old, where there is no hunger, and no one ever runs out of stamina. It is an ideal place for couples who wish to lead a lifestyle that is solely consumed by the desire to continually indulge in pleasure.
Exactly how the passage of time is altered in Pandemonium isn't clear; "space-time is warped by the power of the fallen god, and the same moment continues on forever", but the growth and harvesting of Corruption Fruit implies that there may be some sort of progression from one moment to the next.
The general information on spirit realms suggests that, despite Pandemonium being a different dimension, travel and trade with the regular world is probably common. Dark priests who have finished their missionary activities (by finding a husband) in the human realms retire to Pandemonium with their husbands, but the realm may also serve as a destination for other monsters' honeymoons, and the Sabbath, a sex cut involving loli sex is likely to maintain a branch there as well.

It has no place on the earthen map as it is a magical dimension similar to heaven more than anything else. The only mamono that reside here are: Dark Preists, Dark Angels, and Dark Valkyries.

entries.name: Wonderland
entries.content:
Wonderland is a strange dimension that has no sure way of entering, and at a glance, this mamono realm appears to be bright and rich in nature, and the towns are lined with lovely, fantastical structures, but at the same time, there are plants and structures with something off about them, and objects that seem out of place scattered everywhere. A giant castle based on red and white is situated in the middle of the kingdom where the Queen of Hearts lives.
Since it exists in another dimension, one can't enter without the assistance of the Queen or one of the monster residents. Some people carelessly fall asleep, and wind up there before they realize it. Some people get lost on the road, and arrive there after wandering aimlessly. Some people chase after “Wererabbits” that head off somewhere as if suddenly lured by something. Due to the Queen's prejudice, whim, and arbitrary decisions, many human men and women, monsters, and couples are invited to the kingdom a bit coercively. Also, for some reason, “Wererabbits” and “Alices” are sensitive to when the entrance to the kingdom appears, and it is said that every “Alice” will eventually visit the kingdom without fail. (It seems that if she has a partner, then they'll definitely be invited as a couple.)
Throughout the land, various places, products, and foods are imbued with spells that will irrationally attack visitors, including:
“Cookies that change the body of a man that eats them into a little boy, or the body of a monster (woman) that eats them into a little girl.”
“Cakes that change monsters with a child-like appearance and little girls into the form of alluring adult women if eaten.”
“Tea that causes men who drink it to go mad with lust like a dog, and attack and ravish monster girls.”

All of the obscene happenings that suddenly arise will no doubt confuse the minds of visitors and shake them. Unlike visitors, the denizens of Wonderland will just enjoy sex as a couple if one of these happenings occurs.

The insanely obscene spectacles bewilder visitors at first, but due to the guidance of the denizens of Wonderland, starting with the aptly-known “Cheshire Cat,” eventually they're able to adapt to it, and they too end up becoming one of the denizens of Wonderland.
Human males present at these happenings become married to the monster they had sex with and change into an incubus. Human females completely change into one of the monsters of Wonderland. In this land, one will encounter various happenings, and meet many monsters and couples, but a huge transformation awaits an “Alice” who can overcome these trials and arrive before the queen even while being showered with pleasure.

Also, once an “Alice” becomes complete, she won't lose her memories, even if she goes back outside of Wonderland.)

entries.name: Underworld
entries.content:
The Underworld is where many souls go upon death to be judged. However, even if one is alive, they can go to the Underworld if they're captured by a banshee, or a lich, who both serve Hel, the Goddess of Death. Like the Fallen God and Poseidon, the Sea Goddess, she has been monsterized, and therefore works in opposition to the Chief God in Heaven.
As the goddess of death, her power is required to use advanced Necromancy. She is described as "half living and half dead, i.e., half god and half monster".
She is described as a petite and beautiful girl, graceful and dignified as the daughters of the nobles. Her body is said to live on while greeting death, just like the power she wields-and just like the undead monsters. She is considered a relatively young god of willful and unrestrained disposition, who abhors the idea that death is dark, cold, and sad, and that the dead never return. Dismissing it as a foolish assumption of the old, she promotes the knowledge that death is a new beginning-beyond which lies reunion with loved ones and pleasure unending. As such, she is the most commonly revered deity within the kingdoms of the undead-in place of the Chief God's chalky white churches stand churches of Hel, fine estates decked in red and black, such as Umbra a small nation hidden within Menria that was formed after the great fire of Old Menria.
Hel's followers are promised deaths of everlasting peace- good lives as undead. She lends her power to answer their call, turning the living into the dead and raising the dead as the undead. In the previous Mamono Lord's reign, undead were vulnerable to holy power; lower-order undead were easily wiped out by clerics' spells of light-or even sunlight or prayers. At the time, the undead were quite fragile and weak-but in their new forms, undead races are far more stable. Beyond that, all are protected by the goddess Hel. Even a lower-order undead monster can no longer be eliminated by such methods.

entries.name: Holy Order of the Chief Goddess
entries.content:
[The Order of the Chief Goddess is an anti-monster organization that rules over most of the human world. It is a religious group that worships the Chief God, though it also has military and governmental authority. The Order sees monsters as evil and works to eliminate them, though its treatment of humans is largely benevolent.

The Order has a hierarchical structure, including a Pope, living saints, and an army called the Holy Knights. The Chief Goddess ultimately leads the Order and communicates her will through oracles and angels. The Order's control over society varies in different nations, from limited influence to repressive management. Order lands tend to be prosperous, while monster-friendly states attract troublemakers. Currently, only one Order nation is named: Welsple.

The Order prohibits monsters but tolerates some useful species. Not all Order nations are equally zealous in opposing monsters. The Order relies on monsters for some resources like sea travel and magic gems when necessary.

Groups outside the Order include monster-friendly human nations, secret heresies within Order lands, and non-religious anti-monster groups like Zipangu's Amanomiya clan. The Order accepts non-monstrous non-humans like dwarves, fairies, and elves. The Order tries to convert the half-elf Primera Concerto, showing they oppose her dislike of humans rather than her elven heritage.]

entries.name: Humans
entries.content: [Humans are the most common race though weak compared to monsters and elves. They follow the Order and Chief God, who empowers heroes and sends angels against monsters. The Order opposes monsters but treats humans well. Humans can use essence and elemental magic. Mamono mana turns humans into incubi and monster girls. Elves dislike humans but can breed, producing half-elves. Monster girls interbreed with humans, making more monster girls.]

entries.name: Chief Goddess
entries.content:
[The Chief God is the main deity worshipped by the Order and humans. Commanding angels and valkyries, the Chief God opposes monsters and the Mamono Lord. The Chief God blesses heroes and communicates with devotees.

Order doctrine says the Chief God created the world and humanity, except other gods and monsters from darkness. Humans believe the Chief God is all-knowing and all-powerful, guiding humanity. Worship of subordinate gods like Ares and Eros is allowed. The Chief God teaches virtue, harmony and opposing monsters.

However, the Mamono Lord said the Chief God title belongs to different goddesses. The original Chief God created the world, humanity and monsters. The current Chief God is inexperienced, wounded fighting the Mamono Lord and husband. Unable to attack again, the Chief God raises heroes to slay the Mamono Lord.]

entries.name: Druella

entries.name: Queen of Hearts
entries.content: [The Queen of Hearts is the ruler of Wonderland, a dimension she created. She is a lilim, the third daughter of the Mamono Lord, and Druella's younger sister. Despite her childlike appearance and behavior, the Queen possesses immense power exceeding other lilim. Within Wonderland, she created many monsters by mutating creatures that annoyed her, like mad hatters from matangos, dormice from large mice, and jabberwocks from arrogant dragons. She made cheshire cats and march hares to please werecats and wererabbits. Her greatest creations are the trumparts, human women she transformed into powerful card-themed monsters with abilities reflecting their potential. The Queen can summon trumparts from surfaces with matching card patterns. It is unknown how closely the Queen works with her mother and sisters. She may influence the world from Wonderland like the Fallen God in Pandemonium or focus on her domain.]

entries.name: Heroes
entries.content:
[Heroes are powerful humans who can defeat monsters. They are usually blessed by the Chief God but some have natural talent or train to become heroes. The Order of the Chief God relies on heroes to fight monsters. Some heroes are born with hero potential that valkyries or echidnas may notice. The Mamono Lord's husband was once a hero. Many heroes sent to defeat the Mamono Lord end up becoming incubi.

Though usually meaning those blessed by the Chief God, ""hero"" can refer to anyone who exceeds human limits. Eros blesses some heroes with incubus-level skill. Evidence shows heroes and incubi are the same, breaking limits, but heroes use divine power and incubi use mamono mana. Their abilities remain without the power source. Some believe humans were meant to have unlimited potential, and heroes/incubi regain lost abilities.

The Order forbids studying heroes and incubi but monsters do. Nearly all abilities of incubi and heroes can be gained by the other. Heroes always had the potential for abilities gained as incubi.]

entries.name: Heaven
entries.content:

Heaven houses multiple major gods though only the Chief God is named. Neutral gods may dwell there but corrupted gods are banished.

It is unclear if Heaven is an afterlife for souls though souls exist, becoming ghosts or captured by wisps. Materials on Heaven don't mention souls.]
